## Problem
What problem does this feature solve? Reference specific issues from the performance review or handoff docs if applicable.

## Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you have in mind.

## Alternatives Considered
What alternatives did you consider? Why did you reject them?

## Backtest Plan
How will you validate this feature? Which backtest mode will you use?

## Frozen Parameters
Does this feature require changing any frozen parameters? If yes, which ones and why?

## Research Context
Is this based on a paper, blog post, or existing library? Link it here.
